name: Coordination of Benefits — Echocardiography
description: COB denial. Common in dual-eligible patients. Straightforward appeal with correct payer order.

denial.denialLetterText:
Kaiser Permanente
Claims Adjudication Department

DATE: March 18, 2026

RE: Denial of Claim — 93306 (Transthoracic echocardiography)

Dear Provider,

This letter is to inform you that the claim submitted for the above-referenced service has been denied.

DENIAL REASON: CO22 — This care may be covered by another payer per coordination of benefits

PAYER STATEMENT: Payment adjusted per coordination of benefits rules. Another insurer has been identified as the primary payer for this service.

PROCEDURE: 93306 — Transthoracic echocardiography
DIAGNOSIS: I25.10 — Atherosclerotic coronary artery disease

APPEAL RIGHTS: You have the right to appeal this denial within 120 days.

APPEAL DEADLINE: July 16, 2026

Sincerely,
Claims Adjudication Department
Kaiser Permanente
